note: Sanitized repository-native Obzio workloads. Every argv is either a command the repository's own workflows declare, or a provenance check the PO-03 transactional protocol requires of every producer. No secrets, no network and no third-party service are involved, and no probe writes outside the tree it runs in.

argv_conventions.PYTHON: replaced by the interpreter running the harness, so a runner without actions/setup-python still executes the probe

design: Probes run in declared order against one tree per mode, which is how a single Actions job behaves, so ordered gate probes establish causation. Gate probes p01, p03, p05, p07 and p09 are the same command; a change in a gate's outcome is attributable to the command that ran between it and the previous gate. Probes marked reset_untracked_delta return the tree to the untracked state observed at harness start, and never remove a file the caller already had.

probes.workload: PO-03 ownership gate: the tree must carry no untracked or modified files before the job's workload runs.
argv: import subprocess,sys; out=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip(); print('dirty_paths=%d' % (len(out.splitlines()) if out else 0)); print(out); sys.exit(1 if out else 0)

Portability check on the ambient environment. Fails when provider, agent or credential-shaped variable names are present. Only counts are printed; no variable name or value is emitted, so no secret can reach the evidence record.
argv: import os,re,sys; pat=re.compile(r'CURSOR|ANTHROPIC|OPENAI|CLAUDE|_TOKEN|SECRET|_KEY|AGENT_TRANSCRIPTS|CLOUD_AGENT',re.I); hits=[n for n in os.environ if pat.search(n)]; print('provider_shaped_env_vars=%d' % len(hits)); print('total_env_vars=%d' % len(os.environ)); sys.exit(1 if hits else 0)
probes.expectation_binding_reason: Depends on the ambient environment of the invoking host, not on repository content or clone depth, so it is recorded but not enforced for clean-clone recurrence.

probes.workload: Portability check on TMPDIR. Fails when the ambient temporary directory already holds PO-03 run state, which is the /tmp dependence the commission forbids. Only a count is printed.
argv: import os,glob,sys,tempfile; root=tempfile.gettempdir(); hits=glob.glob(os.path.join(root,'*po03*'))+glob.glob(os.path.join(root,'*wa024*')); print('tmpdir_po03_entries=%d' % len(hits)); sys.exit(1 if hits else 0)
